summary: F4 is resolved. A small bash supervisor now owns the process group: it ignores SIGTERM and stays alive until the output pipes close or cancellation reaches SIGKILL. Termination matches the group only while that supervisor PID is live, so a reused PID can no longer name an unrelated group, and a temp test covers this with a simulated reaped PID. F5 is resolved: the temp shell tests now have explicit time budgets. Durable and temp runs pass, and the coverage gate passes with no uncovered lines. The change is ready.
